state_convention.indices: i,j range over the complete chart state vector in frozen flat-index order
vacuum: eta is fixed during state differentiation
Mbar_infinity value, gradient and Hessian are dependent-observable inputs

linear_scalar_variational_system.base: y'=A(t,p)*y for the augmented first-order scalar Borel state y=(B,V,J1,J2)
matrix_derivatives: A_i is the exact directed derivative through kappa_i and mu_i
A_ij includes A_kappa*kappa_ij+A_mu*mu_ij and every quadratic parameter-chain term
origin data h0 and its state jets enter separately and may not be assumed constant

compressed_parameter_jet_realization.purpose: compute the complete full-state Jacobian/Hessian without integrating one Borel trajectory per full-state index pair
compressed_parameter_jet_realization.vacuum_parameter_tuple: theta=(h0,kappa,Mbar_infinity) with eta held fixed, mu=eta*Mbar_infinity and beta+1=Mbar_infinity*(1-2*eta*kappa^2)/kappa
compressed_parameter_jet_realization.integrated_inventory_per_borel_component: one value, three ordered first parameter partials and nine ordered second parameter partials; both mixed orientations are retained
positive_state_inputs: h0 value, complete state gradient and complete state Hessian from the tail endpoint observable
kappa value, complete state gradient and complete state Hessian
M value, canonical scalar gradient and zero Hessian
vacuum_state_inputs: h0 value, complete state gradient and complete state Hessian from the scaled-tail endpoint observable
kappa_bar value, complete state gradient and complete state Hessian
dependent Mbar_infinity value, complete directed state gradient and complete directed state Hessian
compressed_parameter_jet_realization.eta_rule: eta is an external frozen continuation-cell parameter and has zero state derivatives
compressed_parameter_jet_realization.equivalence_requirement: the composed F_i and F_ij must be exactly the same interval expressions as direct differentiation of the full-state variational equations before any norm projection
compressed_parameter_jet_realization.projection_order: compose every full-state entry first; only then apply the frozen operator/coefficient norm bound

derivative_convolution_rules.second: C_ij=F_ij diamond G+F_i diamond G_j+F_j diamond G_i+F diamond G_ij
derivative_convolution_rules.square_second: (F diamond F)_ij=2*(F_ij diamond F+F_i diamond F_j)

metric_variational_system.derivative_rule: differentiate the unsolved equations before division so denominator, beta, source and integral-state jets are all retained

growth_budget_template.meaning: tiering reserves strict exponential room for variational forcing and polynomial prefactors; it is a proof template, not a proved bound
